title: read
summary: Read a single file from the remote project source tree.
purpose: Read a single file from the remote project source tree.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Path relative to the source root. Absolute paths and '..' are forbidden.

fields.name: max_bytes
fields.description: Maximum bytes to read. If omitted, the whole file is read unless it exceeds the server limit, which returns 413.

fields.name: offset
fields.description: Zero-based byte position where reading starts.

fields.name: length
fields.description: Maximum byte-window length. When used with max_bytes, the smaller value applies.

fields.name: encoding
fields.description: Decoding charset. Undecodable characters are replaced.

fields.name: start_line
fields.description: 1-based line number to start reading from. Must be sent together with end_line, and never together with offset/length/max_bytes.

fields.name: end_line
fields.description: 1-based, inclusive line number to stop reading at. Must satisfy start_line <= end_line. Past EOF, only the available lines are returned.

fields.name: ref
fields.description: Optional committed-tree ref. Omit or send null for the worktree, including uncommitted changes. Accepts head, target_sha, merge_base and merge_tree from merge_preview.

details: Replace {name} in the route with path_parameters.name.
Do not edit the project source on disk directly — every source read and change goes through these tools.
Use source_sha256 from read as the base hash for an edit.

errors.when: The path does not exist or is not a regular file.
max_bytes was omitted and the file exceeds the server limit (a line selector is judged against the same whole-file size).

The path escapes the source root or has an invalid form, the request carries a field read does not allow (reason=unknown_field), or start_line/end_line is invalid (reason=invalid_line_range) or combined with offset/length/max_bytes (reason=line_and_byte_selector).
This token does not have the read scope.
